name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.217: Fixes native apps failing to play federated titles that this server converts. The local conversion request was rebuilt with the friend-facing filter, which removed the player's URL token before Jellyfin generated the playlist links; the app then stopped at 0 seconds or asked to retry with transcoding. The request now keeps its original local parameters and only the bitrate and resolution limits change. Requests forwarded to a friend still have local credentials removed. External-subtitle burn-in on a remote sidecar track can still fail. Physical-device checks remain pending.
